title: 2022 Select Lazer Concourse Red #79 Chris Long Virginia
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2022 Select Chris Long Lazer Concourse Red #79 Virginia University trading card is a must-have for any NFL fan or sports card collector. Featuring the University of Virginia football star, this card is a rare find and a great addition to any collection. The card is part of the 2022 Select set, which is known for its high-quality cards and unique designs.

This particular card is a red parallel/variety, which adds a touch of uniqueness to the already impressive card. It is not autographed or signed by the player, but it still holds a lot of value. The card is manufactured by Select and features the Concourse Laser design. It is a great way to show your support for the Virginia University football team and a perfect addition to any sports memorabilia collection.
